missions.title: Filters for Benthos
missions.summary: Benthos needs filters to service the grow tanks
missions.intent: Without those filters, they can't grow food.

missions.title: Survey Pump Station
missions.summary: Inspect the pump at Pump Refuge.
missions.intent: Hold beside the inactive pump, see what is wrong.

missions.title: Repair Pump Station
missions.summary: Carry the replacement impeller from Cormorant to the Pump Refuge pump.
missions.intent: Once fixed the grow tanks will be online.

missions.title: Survey cargo lift
missions.summary: Inspect the cable housing at Freight Yard. The lift needs replacement cable from Benthos.
missions.intent: Hold beside the inactive lift; reveal the ruined cable and name Benthos as the source.

missions.title: Repair Cargo Lift
missions.summary: Carry cable reels from Benthos to the Freight Yard lift.
missions.intent: Once repaired the workshops and lower gantry will be running again.

missions.title: Relight Deep Anchor
missions.summary: Deep Anchor has called, their light has gone out.
missions.intent: Bring them a new beacon light.

missions.title: Survey deep anomaly
missions.summary: We have been investigating a strange reading, now that you are here can we ask you to investigate it for us?
missions.intent: travel to the lowest depths to examine the mystery.

missions.title: Return home
missions.summary: Carry Deep Anchor's physical survey records and return supplies to Tidewall.
missions.intent: We need to report these findings, travel back to the shallows with the data
